components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Bronze fill, obsidian text; lifts on hover into bronze-hover with a tinted shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-bronze, #C89B5A); color: var(--color-obsidian, #171614); font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 14px 32px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 12px 24px -8px rgba(200,155,90,0.25); transition: all .2s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-bronze-hover, #D8A867); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 16px 28px -10px rgba(200,155,90,0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(200,155,90,.75); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Text-only quiet action used for inline links like '+ Import PGNs'.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--color-bronze, #C89B5A); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; padding: 4px 8px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; transition: background .15s, color .15s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(200,155,90,.1); color: var(--color-bronze-hover, #D8A867); }

components.name: Segmented Tab
components.description: Equal-width segmented control with sliding thumb and sage active underline.
components.css: .ds-tabs { position: relative; display: flex; background: rgba(23,22,20,.7); border-radius: 12px; padding: 4px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(74,68,60,.3); } .ds-tab { position: relative; z-index: 1; flex: 1; background: none; border: none; color: var(--color-faded, #8E8578); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; padding: 7px 8px 8px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: color .2s; } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--color-ivory, #F4EFE7); } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--color-parchment, #B7AFA2); } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"]:before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 4px 0; background: var(--color-slate-ash, #2F2B27); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(74,68,60,.4), 0 2px 10px -2px rgba(0,0,0,.45); z-index: -1; } .ds-tab-bar { position: absolute; bottom: 3px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 16px; height: 2px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-sage, #7FA38A); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .2s; } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] .ds-tab-bar { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Game Card
components.description: Selectable game row with hover lift and bronze activity rail.
components.css: .ds-game-card { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: rgba(34,32,29,.6); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(74,68,60,.3); border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px 16px 16px 18px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; transition: all .2s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-game-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: rgba(47,43,39,.5); box-shadow: 0 12px 24px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.35), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(74,68,60,.5); } .ds-game-rail { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 10px; bottom: 10px; width: 3px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-bronze, #C89B5A); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .2s; } .ds-game-card:hover .ds-game-rail { opacity: .3; } .ds-game-card[data-selected] { background: rgba(47,43,39,.7); box-shadow: 0 12px 24px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.3), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(200,155,90,.4); } .ds-game-card[data-selected] .ds-game-rail { opacity: 1; } .ds-game-names { display: block; color: var(--color-ivory, #F4EFE7); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-game-names em { font-style: normal; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-faded, #8E8578); margin: 0 6px; } .ds-game-result { float: right; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-bronze-hover, #D8A867); background: rgba(23,22,20,.6); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(74,68,60,.4); border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; }

components.name: Evaluation Card
components.description: Compact engine readout: label + live pulse, bronze figure, meta, PV hairline.
components.css: .ds-eval { background: rgba(47,43,39,.45); border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-eval header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .ds-eval h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-faded, #8E8578); } .ds-eval-live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-sage, #7FA38A); } .ds-eval-live i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-sage, #7FA38A); animation: ds-pulse 2s infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 50% { opacity: .4; } } .ds-eval-main { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 12px; margin-top: 10px; } .ds-eval-main strong { font-size: 32px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.02em; color: var(--color-bronze, #C89B5A); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-eval-main span { font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-parchment, #B7AFA2); text-align: right; } .ds-eval dl { display: flex; gap: 24px; margin: 16px 0 0; font-size: 12px; } .ds-eval dt { color: var(--color-faded, #8E8578); } .ds-eval dd { margin: 0; color: rgba(244,239,231,.9); font-weight: 500; } .ds-eval-best { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-bronze-hover, #D8A867); background: rgba(200,155,90,.15); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(200,155,90,.25); border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; }

components.name: Turn Indicator Pill
components.css: .ds-turn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: rgba(34,32,29,.8); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(74,68,60,.4), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.5); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 16px 6px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(244,239,231,.9); text-transform: capitalize; } .ds-turn-dot { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-ivory, #F4EFE7); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.35); }

components.name: Coach Insight Card
components.description: AI Coach placeholder insight with sage-light tag.
components.css: .ds-insight { margin: 0; background: rgba(47,43,39,.4); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; transition: all .2s; } .ds-insight:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: rgba(47,43,39,.6); } .ds-insight blockquote { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.625; color: rgba(244,239,231,.9); } .ds-insight figcaption { margin-top: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-sage-light, #A8C1A5); } .ds-insight figcaption i { width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-sage, #7FA38A); }

narrative.overview: KnightMind is a lacquered, warm near-black chess study where a single brass instrument — bronze — marks everything the engine touches, and a quiet green voice — sage — speaks only for the AI Coach. Surfaces read as stacked lacquer trays rather than floating glass; depth comes from soft black drop shadows with real offset. Whitespace is generous and the board is always the visual hero at roughly 60% of the workspace's attention.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral lacquer ~70%; ivory carries typography
Bronze is the engine's instrument accent (~15%)
Sage is the coach's voice (~5%), always sage-light as small text
One authored motion moment per view; restrained state transitions

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Bronze speaks for the engine, sage speaks for the coach; neither borrows the other's role, and together they stay near 20% of any screen. White carries the words.

rules.name: The Soft Sage Rule
rules.body: Wherever sage appears as text below 12px, use Sage Light (#A8C1A5) for contrast; raw sage is for shapes and icons.

rules.name: The Data Is Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for measurable chess data — notation, evaluations, PV lines — never as a decorative costume.

rules.name: The Lacquer Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest within their tonal layer; elevation is reserved for elements that float or respond.

dos: Do keep the chessboard squares exactly as they are — the board is heritage, not themable surface.
Do theme browser chrome from the palette: selection, caret, scrollbars, focus-visible.
Do label coach placeholder content honestly until the ML pipeline ships.
donts: Don't apply neon, RGB-gaming gradients, heavy glassmorphism, or clutter.
Don't let sage exceed its ~5% presence or speak for anything that isn't the AI Coach.
Don't use unicode glyphs or emoji where drawn SVG icons belong.
Don't market copy like a generic AI startup.
